title: tooltip: PR review flags genuinely-missing tooltips instead of deferring to AA0218
summary: PR review now independently flags genuinely missing tooltips on page fields instead of deferring to compiler analyzer AA0218, which can be disabled or downgraded in team rulesets.
key_points: Adds detection for missing tooltips on bound fields where source field also lacks tooltip
Adds detection for missing tooltips on unbound controls
Preserves existing guard against false positives on inherited tooltips
Clarifies that AA0218 severity is configurable per app and often downgraded
Improves accessibility by ensuring PR review acts as safety net
quote: PR review is the last line of defence.
